;0x00001adb;((self.$R=self.$R||{})["server-fn:0"]=[],($R=>$R[0]={question:$R[1]={id:3553885084,program:100,test:2,skill:6,difficulty:2,isLive:!1,multiChoice:!0,updateDate:$R[2]=new Date("2023-08-02T20:25:59.635Z"),createDate:$R[3]=new Date("2023-08-02T20:25:59.635Z"),externalId:null,ibn:"08155-DC",stem:"\x3Cdiv> \x3Cdiv> \x3Cdiv> \x3Cp>The population \x3Cspan>P\x3C/span> of a certain city \x3Cspan>y\x3C/span> years after the last census is modeled by the equation below, where \x3Cspan>r\x3C/span> is a constant and \x3Cspan>\x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"P subscript 0\">\x3C/span>\x3C/span> is the population when \x3Cspan>\x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"y equals 0\">\x3C/span>\x3C/span>.\x3C/p> \x3C/div> \x3C/div> \x3Cp> \x3Cspan> \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"P equals, P subscript 0, times, open parenthesis, 1 plus r, close parenthesis, to the power y\">\x3C/span>\x3C/span> \x3C/p> \x3C/div>\x3Cp>If during this time the population of the city decreases by a fixed percent each year, which of the following must be true?\x3C/p>",rationale:"\x3Cp>Choice B is correct. The term (1 + \x3Cspan>r\x3C/span>) represents a percent change. Since the population is decreasing, the percent change must be between 0% and 100%. When the percent change is expressed as a decimal rather than as a percent, the percentage change must be between 0 and 1. Because (1 + \x3Cspan>r\x3C/span>) represents percent change, this can be expressed as 0 &lt; 1 +\x3Cspan> r\x3C/span> &lt; 1. Subtracting 1 from all three terms of this compound inequality results in &ndash;1 &lt;\x3Cspan> r\x3C/span> &lt; 0. \x3C/p>\x3Cp>Choice A is incorrect. If \x3Cspan>r\x3C/span> &lt; &ndash;1, then after 1 year, the population \x3Cspan>P \x3C/span>would be a negative value, which is not possible. Choices C and D are incorrect. For any value of \x3Cspan>r \x3C/span>&gt; 0, 1 + \x3Cspan>r\x3C/span> &gt; 1, and the exponential function models growth for positive values of the exponent. This contradicts the given information that the population is decreasing.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>\x3C/p>"},answers:$R[4]=[$R[5]={id:11716,question:3553885084,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cspan class=\"math_expression \">\n            \x3Cspan class=\"math-container\">\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"r is less than negative 1\">\x3C/span>\x3C/span>\n"},$R[6]={id:11717,question:3553885084,correct:!0,content:"\x3Cspan class=\"math_expression \">\n            \x3Cspan class=\"math-container\">\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"negative 1 is less than r, which is less than 0\">\x3C/span>\x3C/span>\n"},$R[7]={id:11718,question:3553885084,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cspan class=\"math_expression \">\n            \x3Cspan class=\"math-container\">\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"0 is less than r, which is less than 1\">\x3C/span>\x3C/span>\n"},$R[8]={id:11719,question:3553885084,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cspan class=\"math_expression \">\n            \x3Cspan class=\"math-container\">\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"r is greater than 1\">\x3C/span>\x3C/span>\n"}],userData:void 0})($R["server-fn:0"]))
